title: Apply a Terraform Template
description: Run terraform init and apply to provision infrastructure.

Octopus.Action.Terraform.WorkingDirector.label: Working directory
Octopus.Action.Terraform.WorkingDirector.helpText: Directory containing .tf files. Defaults to the package extract dir.

Octopus.Action.Terraform.Workspace.label: Workspace
Octopus.Action.Terraform.Workspace.helpText: Terraform workspace to select (created if it doesn't exist).

Octopus.Action.Terraform.Vars.label: Variables
Octopus.Action.Terraform.Vars.helpText: One per line: key=value. Octostache #{...} placeholders are resolved. TF_VAR_* deployment variables are also passed as env vars.

Octopus.Action.Terraform.VarFile.label: Var files
Octopus.Action.Terraform.VarFile.helpText: One per line: path to a .tfvars file.

Octopus.Action.Terraform.BackendConfig.label: Backend config
Octopus.Action.Terraform.BackendConfig.helpText: One per line: key=value pairs passed to terraform init -backend-config.
